sorrows.line: There was no tomorrows, we packed away our sorrows
stanza: And those were the days of roses, of poetry and prose
And Martha all I had was you and all you had was me
There was no tomorrows, we packed away our sorrows
And we saved them for a rainy day

sorrows.songTitle: Death of an Heir of Sorrows
sorrows.line: So let's just call it the death of an heir of sorrows
stanza: When I was summoned to the phone
I knew in my bones that you had died alone
We'd never been promised there will be a tomorrow
So let's just call it the death of an heir of sorrows
The death of an heir of sorrows
When I really feel the years
